description: Scaffolds tgcloud into an existing directory (tgcloud init, offline): tgcloud/schema.js, handlers/, endpoints/, lib/, tgcloud.jsonc, AGENTS.md, docs/tgcloud-sdk.md. In a front-end project it detects the bundler, sets static.source, and adds an npm run deploy script (build, then push) without overwriting files you already have.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

name: init_project
title: Initialize a project in place
